$comment: Hand-maintained map from a roster entry id (or a Mega forme id) to the PokeAPI
`pokemon` slug that carries its sprite. Consulted BEFORE the derived rule in
scripts/build-sprites.mjs, so an entry listed here never touches the derivation.
Add a row when build-sprites prints `UNRESOLVED <rosterId> derived=<slug>`: the
derived slug is not a PokeAPI `pokemon` name. Confirm the real slug against the
fetched PokeAPI index before adding it — an invented slug silently commits the
wrong art, which is worse than a recorded gap. build-sprites also cross-checks
every base-forme id against the entry's National Dex number and refuses to write
if they disagree, which catches an override aimed at the wrong species.
Every row below exists for one of two reasons, and only those two:
1. PokeAPI names a default forme explicitly where Showdown leaves it bare.
Showdown's `Aegislash` is PokeAPI's `aegislash-shield`; Showdown's
`Gourgeist` is `gourgeist-average`. This is not a naming quirk to work
around — the two projects genuinely disagree about whether the default
forme has a name, so no derivation can bridge it.
2. PokeAPI spells a forme suffix out where Showdown abbreviates it.
`Meowstic-F` is `meowstic-female`, `Tauros-Paldea-Aqua` is
`tauros-paldea-aqua-breed`.
Keys are roster ids (Showdown `toID`), never display names. The value after each
key in the review comment below is the display name it belongs to.
